items.markdown:
Ambient sound is `the underlying, constant background audio or atmosphere of a specific location`.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DE6BCwWywtx/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.filmmakersacademy.com/glossary/ambient-sound/)

### Common Types of Ambient Sound

- **Natural sounds:** Rain falling, ocean waves, wind blowing, and birds chirping.
- **Urban and indoor sounds:** Distant traffic, the hum of a coffee shop, or the quiet drone of an office air conditioner.
- **Synthetic noise:** Uniform audio textures like white, pink, or brown noise.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ambience_(sound_recording))[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DE6BCwWywtx/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.noisli.com/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lO1Arcl-o2o)[[5]](https://www.filmmakersacademy.com/glossary/ambient-sound/)

### Uses and Benefits

- **Sound masking:** Constant ambient noise covers up sharp, disruptive spikes in sound pollution.[[1]](https://www.bose.com/stories/what-is-ambient-noise)[[2]](https://www.noisli.com/)
- **Focus and productivity:** Predictable background noise calms the brain's internal alarm system to improve concentration.[[1]](https://www.noisli.com/)
- **Sleep and relaxation:** Steady audio profiles help people fall asleep faster and stay relaxed. You can explore online soundscape generators like [Noisli](https://www.noisli.com/) or [A Soft Murmur](https://asoftmurmur.com/) to customize background audio.[[1]](https://mynoise.net/)[[2]](https://www.noisli.com/)[[3]](https://asoftmurmur.com/)
- **Film and media:** Also known as "atmos" or "room tone," it adds a vital layer of realism and a sense of place to a scene. You can browse collections of [Free Ambient Sound Effects](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/search/ambient/) for creative projects.[[1]](https://www.filmmakersacademy.com/glossary/ambient-sound/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lO1Arcl-o2o)[[3]](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/search/ambient/)
